user.title: Sign in to Volvo AU
user.description:
**[👉 Open Volvo sign-in in a new tab]({authorize_url})**

Sign in with your Volvo ID (email + password) and complete 2FA.

When the browser tries to open `volvooncall://auth/callback?code=…` it will fail to launch — that's expected. Copy the URL from your browser's address bar (or just the `code=…` part, or just the code itself) and paste it below.

data_description.redirect_url: Paste the full `volvooncall://…` URL, or just the code after `code=`.

error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a valid URL or code.
error.oauth_error: Volvo returned an error during sign-in. Please try again.
error.missing_code: Couldn't find a `code` value in what you pasted.
error.auth_failed: Token exchange failed. The login may have expired — please try again.
error.list_cars_failed: Login succeeded but the Volvo API rejected our token.
error.no_cars: No vehicles found on this Volvo account.
